title: RampCast staffing plan output
description: The structured staffing plan produced by the staffing plan generation LLM call. Forced tool-use output for the generate_staffing_plan tool.

planSummary.description: A short narrative summarizing the overall ramp pattern and staffing shape, referencing the comparable projects it was drawn from.

totalDurationWeeks.description: The total duration of the whole project in weeks. This is the single, project-wide week axis every role's rampPattern is measured against — week 1 here is week 1 for every phase, task, and role, regardless of when each of them actually starts or ends.

roleName.description: Role/title staffed on this phase or task, e.g. Project Architect.

rampPattern.description: Week-by-week hours for this role across the entire project timeline. Always exactly totalDurationWeeks long (the shared project-wide week axis) — zero-padded for weeks the role is inactive: leading zeros if it starts later than project week 1, trailing zeros if it finishes before the project ends. Index 0 is project week 1. This lets two roles on different phases or tasks overlap, or run non-aligned spans, while still being comparable on one timeline.

totalHours.description: Sum of the rampPattern hours for this role.

rationale.description: Why this role is staffed this way, referencing the observed pattern in the comparable projects.

wbsCode.description: Task-level WBS code, e.g. CA or SO.

roles.description: Roles staffed directly at the phase level. Populated when the phase has no task breakdown; empty when work is broken into tasks.
